subject: Re: MAP & POC acceptance — timeline and conversion pricing
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@finlytics.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot MAP request & initial timelines

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our engineering and data teams are ready to move forward with a short pilot to validate latency and extraction-quality on credit card and transaction text. To make this official we want a simple mutual action plan (MAP) with milestone dates so procurement can sign off. Key asks from our side: 

- 30k free tokens for a 4-week POC (preferably usable across multiple models)
- A 2-week trial extension beyond your standard onboarding period
- Clear conversion pricing if we move to a committed plan by the end of the pilot

Can you propose a MAP with deliverables, approximate SLAs for throughput, and the conversion pricing we should expect? We can try to get procurement involved if we have a clear table of milestones and acceptance criteria.

Regards,
Sophie Turner
Head of Product, Finlytics
Sophie Turner
Finlytics Inc.

Attachment: Finlytics_requirements.xlsx (xls)
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@finlytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP request & initial timelines

Hi Sophie — appreciate the clear list. Draft MAP below (attached as PDF) and a proposed commercial structure. Let me know which items you want adjusted.

Mutual Action Plan (draft) — Finlytics POC
- Week 0 (signoff): Sign MAP & NDA, Redwood provisions 30k POC tokens, onboarding kickoff (1 day). Target: 2026-11-01
- Week 1 (integration): Data connectors + prompt engineering session (2 calls). Redwood provides sample prompts and baseline evals. Target completion: 2026-11-08
- Week 2 (run & tune): Run test set, measure latency (p95), extraction F1. Redwood will enable prefix-caching & a small dedicated slot. Target completion: 2026-11-15
- Week 3 (acceptance): Finlytics reviews acceptance prompts and signs acceptance form. If acceptance metrics met, Redwood issues POC completion certificate and converts credits for ramp planning. Target: 2026-11-22

Commercial (proposed)
- POC credits: 30,000 tokens (applied immediately upon MAP signature).
- Trial extension: Additional 14 days to sandbox access following onboarding completion.
- Conversion pricing (if committed by 2026-11-30):
  * Standard commit: $0.0008/token for first 6 months, then $0.0010/token thereafter.
  * Early-commit discount: 25% off list for a 12-month commit >= $30k/month equivalent (requires PO).
  * Ramp clause: If usage reaches 60% of committed capacity by month 3, discount steps up to 30% for remainder of year.

I attached a clean MAP + a short term sheet (no legal edits yet). If you want accelerated approval (procurement needs docuSign), we can provide a countersigned term sheet within 48 hours after internal OK.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_POCTermSheet_v2.docx (docx), Finlytics_MAP_v1.0.pdf (pdf)
From: Rajesh Patel <r.patel@finlytics.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@finlytics.com>, Finlytics Procurement <procurement@finlytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP request & initial timelines

Laura — thanks for the draft. A couple of procurement and finance notes before we circulate internally: 

1) We appreciate the POC credits, but procurement wants the conversion pricing to be more certain. Can you confirm the all-in effective rate for the first 12 months under the early-commit discount (25%) and under the 30% ramp scenario? We need a simple per-token effective rate to budget.

2) Procurement would like an additional 2 weeks extension on the trial if we hit integration delays — total extension up to 28 days. Is that possible?

3) Last: we usually require a short SLA clause for latency (p95) for production rollouts — can you indicate objective targets you can commit to for Dedicated or Private deployments (if we move there)?

If you can get the pricing in writing and confirm the extension, we can start an internal procurement review next week.

Thanks,
Rajesh Patel
Director of Engineering, Finlytics

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-10-22T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Finlytics procurement questions — need pricing signoff

Team — Finlytics asked for two things: (1) effective per-token rates at 25% and a potential 30% ramp; (2) extended trial window up to 28 days if integration slips. They also want p95 latency SLAs for production. Can we approve the concession below?

Proposal for internal approval:
- Keep 30k POC tokens as-is.
- Approve 28-day total sandbox extension (i.e., +14 days on top of the 14 we offered).
- Pricing table to confirm to customer: 
  * List list-rate: $0.0011/token.
  * Early-commit 25% -> $0.000825/token effective for 12 months.
  * If ramp to 60% by month 3 -> 30% off -> $0.00077/token (apply retroactively back to month 1 for the committed portion).
- SLA: For Dedicated customers we can commit p95 inference latency <= 220ms (region-dependent) and p99 <= 400ms for production traffic; private deployments will be SLAs via enterprise addendum.

Ben — do we need finance approval for the ramp-sweep retroactivity? Vivek — any concerns on capacity guarantees for a committed customer on the above timeline? Need a quick yes/no so I can respond to procurement by EOD.

Thanks,
Laura
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Finlytics procurement questions — need pricing signoff

Laura — finance reviewed and OK with the two concession items as long as we require a 12-month minimum commitment for the 25% discount and a signed PO before 2026-11-30. The ramp retroactive credit is acceptable but limited to the committed portion only (we won't retro the entire trial usage).

Vivek — engineering will reserve a small dedicated pool for the POC and coordinate capacity if they decide to commit. No blockers from my side.

Ben
Finance, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-11-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final MAP & pricing — updated term sheet attached

Sophie / Rajesh — thanks for your patience. Per our internal approvals, attached is the final MAP and term sheet. Key confirmations below so procurement can circulate the PO/DocuSign: 

- POC: 30,000 tokens applied upon MAP signature (Finlytics_MAP_v1.0.pdf attached).
- Trial extension: total sandbox access = 28 days post-onboarding (14 days baseline + 14 days extension).
- Conversion pricing (requires signed PO by 2026-11-30 to qualify):
  * List-rate: $0.0011/token
  * Early-commit (25%): $0.000825/token for 12 months on a 12-month minimum commitment >= $30k/month equivalent.
  * Ramp credit: If committed usage reaches 60% of monthly commit by month 3, commit receives an additional step-up to 30% off ($0.00077/token) applied to the committed usage retroactively from month 1 (credit applies only to the committed portion).
- SLA: For Dedicated deployments we commit to p95 <= 220ms (region-dependent) and p99 <= 400ms after onboarding/steady state (formal SLA in enterprise addendum).
- DocuSign: I have attached a term sheet and enabled the DocuSign link so procurement can sign. Please confirm by end of day to lock the early-commit pricing; otherwise we can keep the POC and extension but pricing will revert to standard list.

Next steps: 
1) Finlytics signs the MAP/term sheet via DocuSign link (https://www.docusign.com/links/abc123-poc-terms).
2) Redwood provisions POC tokens and schedules onboarding call (within 48 hours of signed doc).
3) Integration & runs per MAP schedule; acceptance signoff triggers conversion planning.

We attached the signed-term-sheet.pdf after countersignature for your records. Let me know if any last-minute edits are needed — otherwise I’ll mark this as ready for procurement routing.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
